info.name: Retrieves a usage consumption summary of a subscriber

params.name: id
params.description: Subscriber ID/ MSISDN of a customer for which usage consumption report to be fetched. example: 250789123456

params.name: usageType
params.description: Type of usage concerned by the bucket, such as voice, sms, data

params.name: senderID
params.description: Identifies the source system which integrates with MAD API

params.name: queryMode
params.description: Query mode for which the request is to be returned, pass 0 or this will be assisgned a default value(0)

items.docs: This operation is used to retrieve usage consumption summary/report of a subscriber.
